risks: Raw persisted session/tool/SDK text and previously downloaded exports cannot be made unread. Do not promise retroactive erasure; retain private authorized owner history while fencing every controlled future retrieval/export/context use. Exact historical download versus hosted summary boundary must be explicit in accepted API/docs.

Partial taint tagging is unsafe: prompt, tool input/result, thinking, nested subagent/call_llm, assistant paraphrase, attachments, notes, summary transfer, previews and error details can all carry derived private information. Removing literal PRIVATE_WP-50 is not adequate redaction.

Unknown or stripped provenance must not default to public. Conservative whole-artifact quarantine/deny is necessary; tainted assistant summaries cannot be safely sanitized by regex or another unaudited model.

Owner bearer capability permits share mutation but proves neither reader identity nor safe audience. Existing viewer receiver needs a source-backed accepted ACL/fence contract; receiver internals were not inspected.

updateShare uploads StoredSession after owner key persistence, and that type contains sharedOwnerKey. Full JSON serialization may disclose secret/path metadata; outgoing projection must allowlist fields and exclude server-only capabilities regardless of renderer stripping.
Existing memory provenance GET_PROVENANCE records lessons/skills, not complete email/tool/summary ACL lineage; reusing the UI does not mean this record already supplies required security semantics.

Filtering search after raw ripgrep cannot guarantee authorized snippets/totals/cursors. Raw preview/header counts, notes/files/watch, transfer import and raw store tools are possible policy bypasses unless shared routes consistently use projections/fences.

Policy can change without content revision; sameContextSnapshot/rebaseLiveContext currently have no policy epoch. Revalidation must occur before publication and future consumption, not just at capture or index update.

Current executor jobs array is in memory and explicitly fixture. Its approvedPayloadHash/send grant must not be treated as artifact read permission, durable outbox or verified live publication receipt.
Current JSONL corruption debug emits raw line prefix; search RPC logs query. Required privacy applies to error/recovery paths too, not only happy-path telemetry.
Three normative agents new paths overlap WP-36. Concurrent creation would overwrite accepted foundations or establish a second convention; domain owner must merge in dependency order.

Body actor spoofing, workspace/account alias collisions, stale CAS, idempotency conflict, provider timeout/ambiguous effect and dropped/reordered invalidation require meaningful negative assertions. A transport wiring test or fixture PASS cannot satisfy feature verification.

Service/migrator/UI/HTTP/viewer/consumer seams outside permitted inspection remain exact root integration prerequisites; this report does not invent implementations or reduce search/mention/notification/activity completeness.

Whole-file hashes bind observed working-tree snapshots only. Root integration can change bytes after inspection; verifier rejection is stale evidence, not grounds to change user source or silently refresh hashes without re-reading affected code.
